Learning guide

Three ideas to become an Earth data detective

You do not need to be a climate scientist. The app explains the evidence behind every result.

01

Trend

A long-term direction in the data. We report how much a variable changes per decade.

02

Significance

A confidence check. It tells us whether the measured direction is clear or still inconclusive.

03

Anomaly

An observation that is unusual compared with the rest of the series. Unusual does not automatically mean dangerous.

03 / Conclusion

—

How did we calculate this?

We remove the regular monthly seasonal cycle, fit a linear regression, and calculate a 95% confidence interval. An Isolation Forest trained on trend residuals and monthly changes highlights unusual observations. The model describes the past; it is not a forecast.

TerraTrend ML

Educational prototype for students and the public. Results do not replace expert-reviewed climate analysis.
